text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah...! Even though Turbo won and 
everything!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo seemed angry about something. 
When I asked her the reason—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teacher lectured meee...! Yesterday I got 
in trouble for doodling, and today for 
dozing off in class!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Turbo was having such a great dream 
about zooming past everyone in first 
place!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The lecture was so long, too... Gaaah! 
Turbo hates lectures!!
